event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Filippo Rebecchi attended hearing as a translator for ITA 222390.
Per Baggoe (coach of DEN) attended hearing as an observer.
facts: ITA 222390 1 boat length leeward and inside of DEN 226296 when entering the zone of mark 4p, both boats on starboard tack and overlapped.
Next to the mark, 1 boat length from the mark and 0,5 boat lengths from ITA 222390, DEN 226296 gybed to port.
Immediately after DEN 226296 gybed, contact occurred between the bow of ITA 222390 and the middle part of the port side hull of DEN 226296, and both boats capsized.
Damage occurred to DEN 226296 as a 30 cm hole in the port side bow of the hull, and boat was taking water in. ITA 222390 had his sail torn.
No boat took a penalty turns.
conclusions: DEN 226296 on port tack failed to keep clear of ITA 222390 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
DEN 226296 outside overlapped at the zone failed to give ITA 222390 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(1).
DEN 226296 did not avoid contact with ITA 222390 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for ITA 222390 to avoid contact with DEN 226296, ITA 222390 did not break RRS 14.
decision: The protest is upheld. Since DEN 226296 took an applicable penalty by retiring, she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).
